example_prompts: Write my weekly update for my VP: we shipped onboarding v2, payments is blocked on legal review, and the churn dashboard slipped a week.
We launched bulk export today for all paid plans. Write a customer announcement and a 150-word summary for my exec team.
Our API migration is slipping two weeks because the vendor sandbox is late. Draft an escalation to leadership that leads with the delay and asks for a decision.
Turn these into a monthly board update: signed 3 new enterprise customers, hiring is a month behind plan, runway unchanged.
